reason: In both app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522 and app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497, `.group-member-info .name` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `(30%, 70%)`. This inadvertently changes its light-theme lightness from 30% to 50%, matching `.title` directly below (desktop/user.scss:527 and mobile/user.scss:503).
